{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a cleaned version of biomarker_baseline where -999.0 is replaced with NaN
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check if the arms are balanced in terms of severity, sex, and age
# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity
arm_severity_ct = pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['severity'])

# Cross-tabulate arm vs sex
arm_sex_ct = pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['sex'])

# Cross-tabulate arm vs age (using median to avoid overfitting)
arm_age_median = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm', dropna=False)['age'].median()

# Print cross-tabulations
print('Arm vs Severity:\n', arm_severity_ct)
print('\nArm vs Sex:\n', arm_sex_ct)
print('\nMedian age by arm:\n', arm_age_median)

# Check if the groups are balanced in terms of baseline biomarker (after cleaning)
baseline_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm', dropna=False)['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print('\nMean baseline biomarker by arm:\n', baseline_by_arm)"}
